title: Hoshino Ichika — Be Careful Of Snatching!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day

rows.Line: Odaiba Animal Land - Petting Zoo

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which animals do wanna go see next, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho and Haruka went over to see the rabbits, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I already got to see a lot of small animals, so I kind of want to meet some of the bigger ones now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then, how about the alpacas?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds fun.
Not to mention they're right nearby.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?!
Then, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That fence must be for the alpaca area!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
There's so many.
They're all different sizes and colors.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And their necks are so long!
Look at that one! It's so fluffy!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I've never seen one up close like this before...

rows.Speaker: Zookeeper
rows.Line: We have food for the alpacas here if you wish to feed them!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, a hundred yen per plate! Let's grab a couple!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Okay.
Excuse me. We'd like to feed the alpacas.

rows.Speaker: Zookeeper
rows.Line:
Of course. Here you are.
You can feed them through the fence over there.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We're the first ones here!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. We came at a good time.

rows.Speaker: Zookeeper
rows.Line:
Oh, please be careful.
They'll all gather 'round at once for the first feeding.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa, yeah! They're all coming over!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, I'll give you one now... No, one at a time...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
W-Wah... They won't stop pushing!
Everyone, please! There's plenty for all of you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hang on... I don't think one plate is going to be enough...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, you're right! I'm almost out...!
They ran through that so fast!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Mine too... They have such big appetites...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This sign says each person can buy up to three plates... What should we do? Wanna go buy some more?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I think I will...
One plate just wasn't enough.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah... The ones who didn't get any food keep staring at me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, they'd probably have us surrounded if it weren't for this fence...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm not worried about the confident ones who push their way to the front, but I also want the ones in the back to get their fill.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. Then, why don't we try to evenly distribute the food a little more?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm all for that!
The ones in the front got everything I just had, so I'll try to give everyone some this time!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll be right back with more food, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Whoa, they're all coming at once...
They really do know when we're carrying food.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait a second, Ichika...
I know we're trying to distribute the food evenly, but do you remember which ones you already gave food to?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hang on... I gave some to this white one, and that brown one... I think...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I lost track too...!
I could've sworn that the black one at the front took basically everything I had...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I don't think that gray one in the back has had any yet!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Then, let's try feeding him!
Hey, Mr. Gray, we have some food for you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, not you guys...
The same ones keep coming back for some reason!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Minori, keep distracting them...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Come here! Now's your chance!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Nice one, Ichika!
He finally got to eat!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, and we can use this strategy to feed the others.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Roger! Next, how about that light brown one? I don't think it's had any yet...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
The one over there?
Okay, you go over to feed it while I distract the others...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Phew... That was a lot of work, but also a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, it ended up being a really great experience.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You were so quick on your feet, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I was...?
I think I got a little carried away after we decided that we were going to feed all the alpacas...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. But that's why our decoy strategy worked so well! I think you have what it takes to become a zookeeper, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I don't know if I actually do, but I really appreciate the compliment.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, the alpacas all seem really happy now... I hope we get to do this again in the future.
